articles.title: Andhra Pradesh eyes key role in Arctic shipping and global trade corridors, says Lokesh
articles.summary: Andhra Pradesh Minister Nara Lokesh pitched the state's 1,000-km coastline and numerous ports as India's gateway to the Arctic logistics network. This initiative aims to leverage AP's robust maritime infrastructure for national strategic interests, enhancing India's global connectivity and trade routes. It signifies a potential boost for maritime commerce and India's geopolitical standing in emerging Arctic trade.

articles.title: 'Trust-based, brotherly relations': Vladimir Putin on India-Russia ties
articles.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin lauded the strong India-Russia relationship, describing it as "brotherly" and "trust-based" across all domains. He highlighted the comprehensive nature of these ties, emphasizing mutual respect and cooperation. This statement underscores the enduring strategic partnership between the two nations, which is vital for global stability and their shared interests. Such robust diplomatic relations are significant for future collaborations and regional dynamics.
